title: Multiple model roots: install overflow across drives
description:
UMBRELLA: MPI-1187 - Model Library housekeeping. Menu: tasks/MPI-1187/plan.md. Joined 2026-10-18 (Fabio, board tidy).

N managed peer roots so a model that does not fit the main drive installs whole to another. Per-model overflow, shared deps found wherever they landed. BLOCKED on MPI-654 and MPI-655 - both are pre-existing install-state bugs this feature turns from rare accidents into one-click Settings actions.
